behavior: The Agents picker orders a session whose effective activity is WaitingInput (any open input_requests on a Connected reporter) ahead of an Unread-only session, keeps ties in tree order, excludes the currently focused session, and renders each candidate's own clause (input needed, Unread, response ready, error observed, unknown observed, unavailable reason).
failure_caught: Picker sorted by the legacy SessionSummary.activity rollup instead of AgentSnapshot::effective_activity, so an agent with an open Input request drops below an Unread agent; or the focused session is offered as a destination.
criticality_reason: Attention routing on a working dashboard: the agent that needs an answer must be first; a wrong order delays the user's answer while other agents wait (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/palette.rs:1661-1710).
signal_reason: Walks all eight queue positions, asserting the highlighted identity, that the focused #1 never appears, and the exact clause for each activity/health state (tests/tui/agent_attention.rs:172-192).
uniqueness_reason: Ordering by effective input and the current-session exclusion are asserted only here; the per-state clause wording is also covered by status_table and unread tests, so the distinct part is the picker order (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/palette.rs:1687-1706).
fidelity_reason: Drives the real Dashboard through the s key into the real palette renderer on a 120x40 TestBackend; protocol snapshots are fixtures, and the picker is the subject (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/palette.rs:7300-7390).
recommendation_reason: The picker-order invariant (effective input first, tree-order ties, current excluded) has no other test.
cost_drivers: Eight full 120x40 TestBackend renders plus one Down dispatch per candidate

behavior: An open Agents picker keeps its candidate order and highlighted identity across a live HierarchyChanged while refreshing the displayed title, the Unread/health clauses and the searchable identity; Enter requests the frozen id and R sends MarkReviewed with the ReadyObservation captured when the picker opened.
failure_caught: A live refresh re-sorts the picker so the highlighted row changes under the user, or R acknowledges the newest observation instead of the one the row displayed, reviewing a turn the user has not seen.
criticality_reason: Marking a different ReadyObservation reviewed acknowledges a response the user never saw and silently clears the newer Unread (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:4777-4790).
signal_reason: Asserts the new title and 'Unread Unavailable' after the event, the SetView target, MarkReviewed expected equal to the captured observation in a rebuilt dashboard, and that the old title no longer matches the filter (tests/tui/agent_attention.rs:195-288).
uniqueness_reason: Frozen-picker live refresh with a captured review identity is distinct; new-candidate freezing is covered by agent_search_snapshot_defers_new_candidates_until_reopening, and R semantics by the unread suite (tests/tui/unread.rs:45-127).
fidelity_reason: Real Dashboard key/event dispatch and palette rendering with in-memory protocol fixtures; the picker plus view request is the subject (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/palette.rs:7300-7390).
recommendation_reason: Only test that refreshes a frozen picker in place and pins MarkReviewed to the displayed observation.
cost_drivers: Two 120x40 renders and a second rebuilt 120x40 dashboard per half

behavior: At 24x9 the compact Agents row keeps the Agent name and its (#id) inside the display-column budget for names of ten e-acute, five CJK 界 and five 🙂 characters.
failure_caught: The width budget measured in bytes or in code points while 界/emoji occupy two columns, so clipping drops the (#id) suffix or cuts a multibyte name and two rows become indistinguishable.
criticality_reason: Narrow-terminal identity confusion among equal titles; the user can widen the terminal or reopen the picker (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/palette.rs:7330-7335).
signal_reason: Counts occurrences of the name's first character in the drawn row (must equal the name's char count) and requires both 'age' and '#2' for three width classes (tests/tui/agent_attention.rs:291-320).
uniqueness_reason: The Unicode display-width boundary of the compact suffix is distinct; the same 24x9 compact row is exercised for duplicate titles by attention_maximum_population (tests/tui/agent_attention.rs:411-453).
fidelity_reason: Real palette layout and clipping on a 24x9 TestBackend; the drawn buffer is what is asserted, with fixture snapshots only as input (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/palette.rs:7295-7345).
recommendation_reason: Only coverage of multi-byte/wide Agent names in the compact picker row.
cost_drivers: Three 24x9 TestBackend draws

behavior: A retained Unread whose reporter is gone renders the compact clause 'Unread Unavailable', while a plain agent with Unknown activity and no Unread renders 'Unknown' and never 'Unavailable'.
failure_caught: Unread shown as live truth after its reporter disappeared, or every Unknown session mislabeled Unavailable.
criticality_reason: A false 'Unread' claims someone still reports the response, and a false Unavailable hides a session that needs the user; both are bounded to status display (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/status.rs:340-405).
signal_reason: Positive and negative substring assertions on the drawn 24x9 rows ('Unread Unavailable', then 'Unknown' && !'Unavailable') after moving the selection (tests/tui/agent_attention.rs:323-371).
uniqueness_reason: The compact values are also asserted directly by status_table and unread_outranks_the_activity_and_keeps_reporter_health; the distinct part is the drawn 24x9 row for the no-reporter case (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/status.rs:1005-1016).
fidelity_reason: Real Status/SessionStatus computation feeding the real compact picker draw; no stand-in for the clause logic (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/status.rs:340-405).
recommendation_reason: Covers the retained-Unread-without-reporter compact branch, which the direct status tests do not render at 24x9.
cost_drivers: Two 24x9 TestBackend draws

behavior: An unavailable reporter with an open Input request keeps both 'input needed' and the published loss reason in the wide picker, and shows Input plus Unavailable together in the 24x9 compact row while project/workspace context stays visible.
failure_caught: Reporting loss represented only by the muted colour (invisible in a copied screen or a non-colour terminal), or the Input clause overwriting the loss reason so the user believes the agent is reachable.
criticality_reason: Interpretation of agent state at a glance; the consequence is bounded to a mistaken status reading (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/status.rs:143-153,399-475).
signal_reason: Substring presence checks over two renders; the wide check requires both 'input needed' and the reason, and the compact check requires codex, Input and Unavailable together (tests/tui/agent_attention.rs:374-408).
uniqueness_reason: Overlaps the unavailable/input clause rows in status_table and the retained-unread compact case; the two-surface textual requirement for a lost reporter with open input is the distinction (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/status.rs:379-445).
fidelity_reason: Real Status computation and real palette/compact rendering; the context substrings come from the rendered frame, not from a copied algorithm (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/palette.rs:7354-7390).
recommendation_reason: The textual-loss invariant is real; the exact source of the 'spaceli' substring in the 24x9 frame was not traced to a production line.
cost_drivers: Two full TestBackend renders at 120x40 and 24x9

behavior: Fifty duplicate-titled agents can be navigated down to #50 while it is offscreen; the 42x12 and 24x9 rows keep #50, Idle and the agent name plus a key hint; a case-insensitive 'nEeDlE #50' filter selects #50 into terminal mode and z then reaches the pty.
failure_caught: Picker navigation clamped to the rendered row count instead of the candidate list, compact rendering dropping identity when titles collide, or the filter omitting the session id/case folding.
criticality_reason: Bounded picker navigation failure at maximum population; the user can type the filter or widen the window (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/palette.rs:1661-1710).
signal_reason: Boundary at fifty candidates, two tiny geometries, duplicate titles, then a positive switch after a mixed-case id filter and a pty byte check (tests/tui/agent_attention.rs:411-453).
uniqueness_reason: Only coverage of scrolling a fifty-candidate picker and of duplicate-title identity in the compact row (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/palette.rs:7295-7345).
fidelity_reason: Real Dashboard navigation, palette rendering and filter path on a TestBackend; fifty sessions are protocol fixtures, which is the right fixture boundary here (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/palette.rs:3110-3140).
recommendation_reason: Protects the offscreen-selection and duplicate-identity behaviour at the population limit.
cost_drivers: 48 Down dispatches and two TestBackend renders per geometry

behavior: The i key visits Input-needed entries before Unread ones in sidebar order, wraps, and emits a SetView; the strip directly above the quota section and the footer name the same queue, and a Busy session with an older Unread is skipped.
failure_caught: Jump and strip computed from two different classifications, or an Unread under a Busy session visited early, sending the user to an agent that is not waiting.
criticality_reason: Attention routing in the sidebar: a wrong queue sends the user to a busy agent and leaves the one needing an answer unvisited (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/attention.rs:53-118).
signal_reason: Asserts the exact visitation sequence [8,9,1,2,8,9], the exact strip text ' ? 3 need input · ✓ 1 ready' at row 32, the footer 'i Next input needed', and a SetView in the outbox (tests/tui/agent_attention.rs:456-486).
uniqueness_reason: The same order, counts, strip position and footer are asserted by the attention.rs unit tests jump_visits_input_then_ready_in_tree_order_and_wraps, strip_sits_above_the_quota_section_and_a_click_jumps_like_the_key and browse_footer_names_the_jump_only_while_a_session_needs_you; only the legacy-rollup fixture differs (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/attention.rs:380-520).
fidelity_reason: Real Dashboard keys, tree and render; protocol fixtures are the input, and the integration draws the same screen the unit tests do (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/attention.rs:121-166).
recommendation_reason: Overlap with the attention.rs unit tests is partial, not subsuming: they use a different fixture (no legacy-rollup conflict) and the key-driven walk from a quiet row is only here. Removing it would lose that fixture and the 120x40 strip/footer composition (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/attention.rs:380-520).
cost_drivers: Six i dispatches and three 120x40/88x38 TestBackend renders

behavior: While Control is held the first nine visible running Agent rows get [1]..[9] badges without changing the status/title columns or the row count, and releasing Control restores the unlabelled rows.
failure_caught: A badge inserted before the glyph shifting every title column, an extra row per label, or the focused agent left unlabelled so Ctrl+1 does not exist.
criticality_reason: A mislabeled or shifted row makes the user pick a different agent than the badge shows; the hold can be released harmlessly, so it is bounded (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/render.rs:1300-1330).
signal_reason: Compares each labelled row's text after five cells with the pre-hold row, asserts the row count is unchanged, checks labels [1]/[2]/[3], and checks the unlabelled restore (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:92-162).
uniqueness_reason: session_jump_single_digit::first_nine_labels_follow_drawn_title_rows_in_wide_and_narrow_frames asserts the same skip(5) column equality and row-count invariant at three sizes, and releasing_without_a_digit_cancels_without_selecting covers the restore (tests/tui/session_jump_single_digit.rs:191-254,338-349).
fidelity_reason: Real sidebar renderer and the real modifier-event path on a TestBackend; the badge placement is the subject (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/render.rs:1300-1330).
recommendation_reason: Same geometry and restore contract as the named session_jump_single_digit tests, at one instead of three sizes (tests/tui/session_jump_single_digit.rs:191-254).
cost_drivers: Three 120x40 renders per phase and two modifier events

behavior: Ctrl+2 selects the frozen second target exactly once (one SetView, footer 'Session selected'), refuses further keystrokes and a second digit while the view is acknowledged but Control is still held, and after release refuses the queued input with 'input was not sent'.
failure_caught: Typing reaching the new agent before Control release or before the view drains, a second destination accepted while the first is in flight, or queued input replayed into the new agent.
criticality_reason: Wrong-ownership input: bytes typed for the old agent could be delivered to the newly selected one (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1234-1330,1385-1445).
signal_reason: Asserts one SetView, DashboardAction::None for the held keystroke, an empty outbox, the repeat-digit refusal, and the 'input was not sent' footer after release (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:165-241).
uniqueness_reason: Only test here of one-destination-per-hold plus the post-release input refusal; session_jump_retained covers release-and-ack gating for retained runs with a different fixture (tests/tui/session_jump_retained.rs:184-248).
fidelity_reason: Real event dispatch, sidebar-jump state machine and outbox; the model-level outbox is the correct boundary before the PTY (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/hints.rs:12-18).
recommendation_reason: Protects the single-destination and post-release input boundary that no other test asserts.
cost_drivers: Two full sidebar renders and one acknowledged view round trip

failure_caught: Badge width computed without Unicode display width, so a wide or combining title shifts and the advertised PTY size changes.
criticality_reason: Layout/identity drift at supported sizes; the copy is visually wrong but navigation still works (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/render.rs:1300-1330).
signal_reason: Per size it asserts the labelled suffix equals the pre-hold suffix, the row count is unchanged, and pane_rects is identical (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:244-311).

fidelity_reason: Real render and pane geometry at each size on a TestBackend; no stand-in for the layout (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/render.rs:1300-1330).

cost_drivers: Six full TestBackend renders (two per size)

behavior: Either Control key keeps the hold alive and releasing both ends it; with the sidebar hidden no labels are drawn and Ctrl+digit is not intercepted — in Browse it does nothing, in Terminal it stays the NUL byte for Ctrl+2 with no dashboard request.
failure_caught: Releasing the left Control ending a hold started with the right one, or the hidden sidebar swallowing Ctrl+2 so a program loses its NUL input.
criticality_reason: Terminal Ctrl+digit is real program input; intercepting it loses bytes the program expects, and a shared-hold bug hides the gesture mid-selection (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1234-1330).
signal_reason: Left/right release sequencing, hidden-sidebar negatives, then a Terminal-mode PtyBytes([0]) positive with an empty outbox (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:314-399).
uniqueness_reason: The hidden-sidebar versus Terminal-mode routing of Ctrl+digit appears only here; operator_control_jump_does_not_reveal_its_on_demand_sidebar covers the Operator sidebar, not NUL routing (tests/tui/operator.rs:252-330).
fidelity_reason: Real modifier state machine and terminal-mode encoding; the outbox is checked instead of a real PTY, which the claim does not require (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1234-1330).
recommendation_reason: Unique protection for the hidden-sidebar Ctrl+digit passthrough and the two-key hold.
cost_drivers: Multiple full sidebar renders and a split-free terminal entry round trip

failure_caught: The Command shortcut consumed by the hold (host shortcut dead) or treated as cancel-with-navigation, moving the selection.
criticality_reason: Bounded to one host shortcut during a transient gesture; releasing Control is a workaround (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1181-1210).
signal_reason: Asserts DashboardAction::None, unchanged focus, labels gone and the exact footer after the Super-Backspace event (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:402-432).
uniqueness_reason: session_jump_single_digit::cmd_backspace_cancels_without_navigation_or_child_input asserts the same cancel, same footer, hidden labels and empty outbox for the same Super-Backspace key (tests/tui/session_jump_single_digit.rs:107-162).
fidelity_reason: Real event dispatch through the shared gesture and keymap; no stand-in for the modifier routing (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1140-1215).
recommendation_reason: session_jump_single_digit::cmd_backspace_cancels_without_navigation_or_child_input drives the same key, but never asserts the returned DashboardAction, so it would not catch a cancelled hold that skips the redraw; keep this real-key integration row (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:402-432).
cost_drivers: Two sidebar renders plus one footer render

behavior: With the Standard input profile, the Control hold never labels or advertises itself, Cmd-k is not stripped into the Browse k binding, Ctrl+2 stays the ordinary NUL Terminal byte, and the footer and focus are unchanged.
failure_caught: The OVRCR-GUI-only gesture or Command folding enabled in an arbitrary terminal, stealing a program's Ctrl+2 NUL or the user's Cmd-k.
criticality_reason: Lost terminal input: a program that expects Ctrl+2 gets nothing, and Cmd shortcuts become Browse actions (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/mod.rs:110-118; keymap.rs:440-470).
signal_reason: Compares the footer string before and after, asserts no labels, unchanged focus, empty outbox, PtyBytes([0]) in Terminal, and the env-value mapping (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:435-487).
uniqueness_reason: Only test of the input-profile gate for this gesture; palette and operator suites assume VerifiedOvrcrGui (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/keymap.rs:440-470).
fidelity_reason: Real profile parsing, keymap gate, event dispatch and terminal encoding; the subject is Dashboard dispatch, not a child process (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/mod.rs:110-118).
recommendation_reason: Unique guard against enabling GUI-only input handling in a standard terminal.
cost_drivers: Four full renders and one terminal-mode entry

failure_caught: The Command modifier matched as a Control edge, so pressing Cmd labels agents and swallows Cmd+digit shortcuts.
criticality_reason: Bounded gesture confusion; no navigation or input occurs while the wrong hold is active (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1145-1160).
signal_reason: Two explicit negatives (Super press, Super+digit) plus focus and outbox assertions (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:490-514).
uniqueness_reason: The bare Super-press negative is unique; command_shortcut_cancels_control_hold only covers a Super key during an existing hold (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:402-432).
fidelity_reason: Real modifier-edge matching and keymap; the Dashboard dispatch is the subject (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1145-1160).
recommendation_reason: Covers the Command-is-not-Control edge directly; no other test presses LeftSuper alone.
cost_drivers: Two full sidebar renders

behavior: Ctrl-o during a live hold still opens the Operator quick message and the hold labels disappear.
failure_caught: The hold eating Ctrl-o, making the operator quick message unreachable while Control is down, or the overlay leaving jump labels visible.
criticality_reason: Bounded: one global shortcut is unreachable during a transient gesture (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1181-1210).

recommendation_reason: Protects the Ctrl-o reservation during the hold, which no sibling test covers.
cost_drivers: Two full 120x40 renders

failure_caught: The hold swallowing Ctrl-g so the dashboard's double-key palette chord is dead until Control is released.

uniqueness_reason: Same cancel-without-navigation family as the Command and Ctrl-o tests, but a distinct chord and the only test that drives ':' after a hold (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:402-432).

recommendation_reason: Covers the Ctrl-g plus palette handoff, which no other test drives.
cost_drivers: Two renders at 120x40

behavior: The 'Ctrl hold Jump to visible Agent' binding is discoverable in the Browse footer, the Space-v key popup and the command palette search.
failure_caught: The gesture exists but is unlisted in one surface after a rename, so users cannot find it.
criticality_reason: Discoverability only; no product behaviour or state is protected (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/keymap.rs:440-470).
signal_reason: Substring presence in three rendered surfaces; broad, though it would catch a renamed or dropped binding (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:572-588).

behavior: While Control is held, an inserted agent and a replaced run do not renumber frozen labels; the replaced target loses its badge, its digit reports 'Agent unavailable' without moving focus, and a still-valid digit then switches to session 3.
failure_caught: Frozen targets renumbered by a live HierarchyChanged so Ctrl+2 selects a different agent than the badge showed, or one unavailable label poisoning the remaining labels.
criticality_reason: A renumbered label is a wrong-target switch, and the switch path can then carry input to the wrong agent (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1103-1120,1293-1320).
signal_reason: Asserts label presence and absence per row, an unchanged focus after the refused digit, the 'Agent unavailable' footer, and a successful retry to 3 in one flow (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:591-656).

fidelity_reason: Real sidebar labels, hierarchy events and the jump state machine; the model-level outbox is sufficient for the claim (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1103-1120).
recommendation_reason: Adds insertion/replacement/retry to the frozen-label contract and checks no renumbering.
cost_drivers: Three full sidebar renders across two hierarchy snapshots

failure_caught: Two-digit or tenth labels, or a footer advertising a digit range that does not exist.
criticality_reason: A wrong range makes the user press a digit that selects nothing or the wrong agent; bounded (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1064-1082).
signal_reason: Asserts [1] and [9] present, [01] and [10] absent across rows, the footer text, then a real 's' open (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:659-705).

fidelity_reason: Real render, footer and picker entry; the badge count rule is the subject (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1064-1100).
recommendation_reason: The single-digit rule and footer are already asserted by the named session_jump_single_digit test at population boundaries (tests/tui/session_jump_single_digit.rs:57-104).
cost_drivers: Two full 120x40 renders and a release event

failure_caught: The picker offering a shell or the focused session as a destination, or a case/word mismatch hiding or mis-selecting an agent, or the palette left open over a terminal.

fidelity_reason: Real hierarchy enumeration, picker filter and confirm path through the real Dashboard; fixtures provide the sessions (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/palette.rs:3110-3140).

failure_caught: Enter silently switching to a paused session or a superseded run, or falling back to a neighbouring candidate.
criticality_reason: The stale destination is a different process instance; switching there would bind the pane to a run the user did not choose (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/palette.rs:172-190,4373-4384).

fidelity_reason: Real refresh_agent_search, reason computation and confirm path; snapshots are fixtures, which is the claimed boundary (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/palette.rs:1711-1721).
recommendation_reason: Covers the paused and run-replaced candidate cells with a no-revive positive.
cost_drivers: Three palette renders and two view-less Enter dispatches

behavior: An open picker ignores a newly arrived agent until it is closed and reopened, then lists the new session.
